answer: Countersignatures carry the weight. An attestation counts only once two identities sharing neither a funding ancestor nor a subnet with you sign the same txid, and reciprocity caps at three per epoch so rings cannot specialise. Countersigners read first, fifteen minutes a transaction, rejecting a quarter they see. Fifty clones need two thousand outside signatures an epoch, 500 hours of strangers reading, twelve graded answers each, and 500 POA bonded. Beacons earn the ships that steer by them; willow cuttings share one root, and no voyage begins without a harbour that will take the hull.
